plan.p0: Mechanism: Preserve every 5 and recolor each 2 having a 5 in its 3×3 Moore neighborhood to 1. Distinguishing assumption: the halo is a one-cell, 8-connected dilation applied independently to every seed.
plan.p1: Mechanism: Preserve 5s and apply the same one-cell Moore halo, but choose the halo color as background minus one. This gives 2→1 in the observed grid. Distinguishing assumption: output color is derived from the background rather than fixed; other backgrounds would produce different colors.
plan.p2: Mechanism: Only cells equal to 5 emit a one-cell 8-connected halo, recolored 1; all other input colors are ignored or preserved. Distinguishing assumption: 5 has special semantic status, so grids whose marked objects use another color would behave differently.
plan.p3: Mechanism: Treat 8-connected groups of 5s as objects, preserve each object, and color the one-cell exterior perimeter around each group 1. Distinguishing assumption: dilation is component-based rather than seed-based, potentially changing behavior for enclosed gaps, touching groups, or complex object shapes.
